FINAL CANDIDATE (with caveat clearly stated — no fabricated pathway names):

THE KEGG OVER-REPRESENTATION ANALYSIS COULD NOT BE EXECUTED in this environment: KEGG data is unreachable (no internet — DNS resolution fails for rest.kegg.jp/kegg.jp; no local KEGG database or gene→KO mapping files anywhere in the workspace; no R + clusterProfiler; no importable KEGG Python packages — keggpy/gseapy/KEGGwrapper/bioservices all ModuleNotFoundError; no pip index to install any of them). Therefore I CANNOT report the two pathway names and will not guess them.

WHAT WAS FULLY EXECUTED AND VERIFIED (evidence: kegg_ora_analysis.py, out/run_log.txt):
1. Parsed all three results tables (res_1vs97/98/99.rds; Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14; 5828 genes × 6 numeric columns: baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj) with a custom pure-Python parser — the files are a non-standard RDS-like binary (1-byte-length strings + big-endian double columns), validated via internal consistency (pvalue ≈ 2·Φ(−|stat|)).
2. Extracted the significant DOWNREGULATED genes per the question's criteria (RAW pvalue < 0.05 AND log2FoldChange < −1.5): strain 97 → 166 genes; strain 98 → 173 genes; strain 99 → 397 genes. (Transparency: with BH-adjusted padj < 0.05 instead: 163/170/394.) Gene lists saved: out/downregulated_97.txt, out/downregulated_98.txt, out/downregulated_99.txt.
3. Intersection of downregulated genes across all three strains: 5 genes — PA14_00570, PA14_13370, PA14_23570, PA14_26020, PA14_31720 (out/downreg_intersection_rawp.txt).

WHERE IT STOPPED (exactly): the KEGG data-fetch step — urllib.request.urlopen("https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pai") → URLError: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution (captured in out/run_log.txt).

The complete pipeline — PA14_XXXXX → paiXXXX → KO mapping, background = all 5828 genes (unmapped dropped), per-pathway one-tailed hypergeometric test with Benjamini–Hochberg correction, intersection of pathways with adj.Pvalue < 0.05 across all three strains, and filtering to the KEGG category 'Cellular processes' — is implemented and unit-tested in kegg_ora_analysis.py and will produce the two-pathway answer the moment it is run where KEGG is available (internet/KEGG REST, a local KEGG mirror/bundle for organism 'pai', or R + clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG).
